svg.title: Inside BoostPoseGraph
svg.desc: The seven template parameters of boost::adjacency_list as BoostPoseGraph fills them, and what Boost stores for Vertex 44: a vector entry holding the pose and two edge lists that point into one graph-wide edge list, where each edge's index and Transition are stored once.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: 1 The type: boost::adjacency_list has seven template parameters

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Boost's parameter names (top) and what BoostPoseGraph passes (mono). The last two are not passed, so they take Boost's defaults.

g.text: Parameter 4 is named VertexProperties: data Boost keeps next to each vertex. The vertex itself is always

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: vertex_descriptor, which Boost derives from parameter 2: with vecS it is the vector index. That index is what every

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Boost algorithm takes, and it makes per-vertex arrays plain vectors (dist[v], MakeVertexVectorPropertyMap<T>).

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
